Bench: Nikhil S. Kariel
 
 C/Sca/14650/2025 Order

DATE  
 IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/SPECIAL CIVIL APPLICATION NO. 14650 of 2025  ==========================================================
 PRABHUBHAI MADHABHAI CHAUHAN  Versus  THE STATE OF GUJARAT & ANR.
 ==========================================================
 Appearance:
 MS RAKSHA S KHATED(12987) for the Petitioner(s) No. 1  MS NIRALI SARDA, AGP for the Respondent(s) No. 1,2  ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE NIKHIL S. KARIEL  Date : 03/11/2025  ORAL ORDER 1. Heard learned Advocate Ms. Raksha S. Khated for the petitioner and learned AGP Ms. Nirali Sarda for the respondent-State.
2.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
By way of this petition, the petitioner questions the in action on the part of the respondent authorities in issuing appointment order to the present petitioner, more particularly considering that the petitioner has been issued a call letter for district selection which was to take place on 03.10.2025.
3.

It is the case of the petitioner that the petitioner had informed the respondent authorities as regards an FIR pending against the present petitioner under the provision of Section 498A of the Prabhubhai Madhabhai Chauhan vs The State Of Gujarat on 3 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161800093/
1 Indian Penal Code etc. and whereas it is submitted by learned Advocate Ms. Khated that the petitioner had been orally informed that he would not be permitted to continue in the selection process any further.
4. As against the same, learned AGP Ms. Sarda for the respondent- State would submit that the case of the petitioner is under consideration and whereas learned AGP tenders copy of a communication dated NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/14650/2025 ORDER DATED: 03/11/2025 undefined 10.10.2025 issued by the respondent No.2 calling for appropriate instructions from the Education Department of the State Government as regards four candidates including the present petitioners against whom criminal cases were pending.

entities.text: Prabhubhai Madhabhai Chauhan vs The State Of Gujarat on 3 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned AGP would submit that given some time, the State would take an appropriate decision and whereas the same would also be intimated to the petitioner.
5. Considering such a position, to this Court, nothing further is required to be done except directing the State to take an appropriate decision and inform the petitioner accordingly.

Hence, the following directions :
(i) The State Authorities to take an appropriate decision inter alia as regards issuing appointment order to the petitioner within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of this order.
(ii) The decision which would be taken by the respondent authorities shall be intimated to the petitioner in writing.

In case the petitioner is aggrieved by the same,
it would be open by the petitioner to assail the same before appropriate forum in accordance with law.
6. With the above observations and directions, the present petition stands disposed of.
It is clarified that this Court has not gone into the merits of the issue.
7. The copy of the communication dated 10.10.2025 is taken on record.

(NIKHIL S. KARIEL,J) BDSONGARA Prabhubhai Madhabhai Chauhan vs The State Of Gujarat on 3 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161800093/
